title: Experience the Power of Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to bring you unparalleled insights.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Experience unparalleled control over your embedded files with new tools that allow you to easily upload, download, remove, and customize how your content appears directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page now provides a transparent and exciting overview of recently shipped updates, what's coming next, and our ambitious future plans.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: We've rolled out a significant upgrade to our checkboxes, making them larger, simpler to click, and fully draggable for a more intuitive and integrated experience.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: Experience unparalleled ease and clarity when collaborating with your team, thanks to significant improvements in our real-time editor.

title: Effortless Collaboration & Discovery
summary: We've made it simpler than ever to find, view, and collaborate on shared items, empowering you to connect and co-create with ease.

title: Unleash Noeko in Your Language
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to offer comprehensive support for a wide range of international languages, making it accessible to users worldwide.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, giving you maximum control and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Smarter Visual Knowledge Maps
summary: Transform your visual knowledge map into a dynamic workflow companion by filtering content by tags, time, and shared connections to uncover new insights and streamline your work.

title: Precision Search & Custom Collections
summary: Unlock powerful new filters and sorting options to precisely navigate your knowledge and save your refined searches as custom, accessible collections.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: Organize your thoughts more intuitively and gain deeper insights with flexible new display options for linked content within your notes.

title: Noeko: Empowering Flexible Hosting and Advanced Plans
summary: Prepare to elevate your experience as we officially launch Noeko's self-hosting capabilities and flexible premium plans, giving you complete control over your data and access to advanced features.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Enhanced Themes
summary: Soon, you'll enjoy a wider selection of professionally designed themes, alongside significant enhancements to our existing visual styles, creating a truly personalized experience.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: Experience a perfectly timed welcome every time you log in, as we fine-tune our greetings to precisely match your local time.

title: Streamlined Tag Actions
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by quickly unassigning tags from multiple items with new bulk actions, making your workflow smoother than ever.

title: Unlock More Ways to Input Your Knowledge
summary: We are dramatically expanding the types of content you can bring into the platform, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to give you a comprehensive hub for all your valuable information.
